name: mothership-night
notes: Mothership nautical concept, NIGHT head-on version (Colby, typed 2026-09-08 ~11:30: the ship emerging through the rainbow, dead centre, mist over water lit by the rainbow and the ship lights; the rainbow fades, the mist rolls over, the ship arrives front and centre). Three Seedance shots chained through the position-locked keyframes (K1→K2, K2→K3, K3→K4) as first and last frames, one continuous locked-off take, then black. Native sea ambience.

render.prompt: The empty night sea under a luminous double rainbow whose colours light the black water; thin mist drifts over the surface. Slowly, far away on the horizon, exactly under the apex of the rainbow, a tall three-masted 1800s ship of the line appears bow-on as a tiny cluster of warm lantern lights reflected on the water, and begins to approach; the mist thickens slightly. Photoreal live-action night cinematography, one continuous locked-off shot from just above the water, dead centre on the ship’s course; the camera does not move; the ship stays exactly on the vertical centre line and only grows as it approaches, always bow-on; long slow black swells, drifting sea mist, deep clean blacks with detail, cool indigo shadows, the only warm light from the ship’s lanterns, soft halation, fine film grain; no people, no text, no logos. Ambient sound only: the sea at night, a low wind, the creak of rigging and a faint ship’s bell.
